conflicts.resolution: Not a conflict: F0048 (33.8 EUR M ARR at start of 2025) and F0049 (3.1 EUR M churned in 2025) are different measures of the same cohort (stock vs flow); both are used as such.

Not a conflict: F0054 (34% of lost deals cite price, sales-reported, prospects) and F0064 (58% of churned customers never fully implemented; 14% cite price) measure different populations. Both are used: price matters in acquisition, implementation failure in churn.
